nodes.label: Library Methods by Concern (ADR 0146)
nodes.rationale: Library's methods organized by concern in src/lib/library/*.ts: glueFolder, profiles, collections, folders, djLibraries, edits, files, analysis. New methods go in their concern's part, keeping field order.

nodes.label: GLUE: Global Library Unified Exporter
nodes.rationale: Renamed from MCO (Music Collection Organizer) on 2026-09-25 (ADR 0035). Formerly Speklone. Local-first DJ app: builds collection, analyzes, manages playlists, finds duplicates, exports to DJ apps.

nodes.label: Speklone: Spectral Forensics Origin
nodes.rationale: Original spectral forensics tool ('is this hi-res actually hi-res?'). Became GLUE's per-track Inspector and Analyze a file mode.

nodes.label: TypeScript 6 + Svelte 5 + Vite 8
nodes.rationale: Website tech stack. npm run dev, check, test. Playwright E2E (heavy for multi-browser/GLUE Home, e2e for rest). Per-test times in test-results/durations.json.

nodes.label: graphify: Code Map Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: graphify-out/graph.json maps code (tree-sitter: files, symbols, imports, calls, SQL migrations) and vault (ADRs, features, articles). Vault first (why), graphify to find files, source last. graphify affected/explain/path for lookups, never query.

nodes.label: src/platform/: OS Access Layer
nodes.rationale: OS access only through src/platform/ (ADR 0007): browser's handles or GLUE Home's disk in Home mode. Abstracts platform dependencies.

nodes.label: Lease: One Writer at a Time
nodes.rationale: One writer of GLUE folder at a time (ADR 0051): tab in Home mode writes only while holding GLUE Home's lease; GLUE Home writes only while no lease held.
